about: kb-v2 C17 evaluation questions whose answers are in NON-core laws (only in the sectioned corpus, records_all/, or the scraped records, scraped/records/statutes/). Written and committed BEFORE any C17 code change; not to be edited after results. 'expected' = accepted [law title as in the records, section] pairs (any one counts); every pair was checked to exist in the records before committing. Questions are phrased as a user would ask, without section numbers.
